explanation: Try shifted divisors from the highest possible quotient bit downward. Subtract a shifted divisor when it fits and set the corresponding result bit, without using division or multiplication.
timeComplexity: O(B) bounded-width arithmetic steps for B input bits
spaceComplexity: O(1) fixed-width registers; O(B) bits for arbitrary-size Python integers
attribution: Original Python implementation authored for EPI Practice from its displayed contract and independently authored C# solution; no upstream reference source adapted.
